name: cfpb.api
what_it_holds: R package (also forked/maintained at riddlet/cfpb.api) that wraps the CFPB public Consumer Complaint Database API for programmatic querying/filtering by product, company, state, date.
why_useful: Alternative-language client for the same official complaint database; useful if the team's pipeline is R-based, and as a cross-check implementation against the Python downloader above.

name: mcp-cfpb
what_it_holds: An MCP (Model Context Protocol) server wrapping the free, no-auth CFPB Consumer Financial Protection Bureau complaint database API, exposing search/query tools an LLM agent can call directly.
why_useful: Would let an agent query live CFPB complaint counts/trends (e.g. 'Money transfer' or 'Credit card/Prepaid card' complaints mentioning specific BNPL lenders) on demand without hand-rolling API calls; very fresh (13 Sep 2026), so still active.

name: better-business-bureau-bbb-complaint-scraper
what_it_holds: A scraper targeting Better Business Bureau (BBB) complaint pages to extract complaint text/metadata for a given company.
why_useful: Method only (no committed data) that could, if run against Airbnb's or a BNPL provider's BBB profile, produce a complaint-volume/complaint-text time series; per the rules this is catalogued as a method and left unrun (BBB scraping is a terms-of-service call for a human).
